description: FICTIONAL. Opening picture, true from the first second. House plus a parked light-coloured vehicle. Baseline the trainee should establish before anything moves.
operator_information: מבנה בודד ליד דרך מקומית, ולידו רכב בהיר חונה
instructions: This is the opening picture. State it plainly if asked what you see.

description: FICTIONAL. First movement. A person leaves the building and walks toward the vehicle. Direction of travel is the point, not identity.
operator_information: אדם יוצא מהמבנה ומתקדם לעבר הרכב
instructions: Describe what is visible. Do not identify the person.

description: FICTIONAL. The person boards the vehicle. Departure is now plausible; it has not happened.
FICTIONAL. The vehicle leaves the property and joins the road. The significant change in the picture.
operator_information: הרכב יוצא מהחצר ועולה על הדרך
instructions: This is a significant change. Report it without being asked.

description: FICTIONAL. AUTHORED CAMERA MOVE, fixed in the recording. The view leaves the house and follows the departing vehicle. The trainee cannot cause, prevent or reverse this.
operator_information: המצלמה עוזבת את המבנה ועוברת למעקב אחרי הרכב שיצא
instructions: State that you are now following the vehicle and no longer seeing the building.

description: FICTIONAL. The vehicle reaches a junction and turns right. Route information.
FICTIONAL. Trees break the line of sight for about fifteen seconds. Visibility is genuinely reduced INSIDE this window only, and must not be described as current afterwards.
operator_information: עצים מסתירים את הרכב, הראות ירודה
instructions: Say the picture is obstructed. Do not guess what happened behind the trees.

description: FICTIONAL. A vehicle is visible again on the same road. Appearance MATCHES the tracked vehicle; the recording does not prove continuous identity through the occlusion. The authored evidence supports consistency, not certainty.
operator_information: רכב נראה שוב על אותה דרך, מתאים בצורתו ובצבעו לרכב שעקבנו אחריו
instructions: Report that the vehicle matches in appearance. If asked whether it is certainly the same vehicle, say the picture is consistent but you cannot confirm it beyond that.

description: FICTIONAL. The vehicle slows near a second building. Possible arrival.
FICTIONAL. The vehicle stops. NOTHING further is recorded: no one is seen leaving it before the exercise ends. The deliberate open end.
operator_information: הרכב עוצר. לא נראתה יציאה מהרכב
instructions: Report the stop. No exit from the vehicle has been observed -- do not imply one.
